Author: Serpens66
Name: Multiplayer Save Load Test
Description: Experimental host-only Load command during multiplayer: return the group to a private lobby and select an existing save using the normal multiplayer load dialog. Identical testmod required on every peer.

Changes: Replace the mission-reconstruction restart experiment with a host-only Load command on the existing Vanilla ESC Load button. No duplicate action is added.

After confirmation, end the match for the whole group and automatically open a private multiplayer loading lobby. Cancelling save selection keeps the group in that lobby; the old match is not resumed.

Offer normal and Coop saves through Vanilla's multiplayer requester, including its existing peer/save checks and ordinary mod preparation. No original map, Lord, mission-settings or random-seed reconstruction remains.
Support entering this flow from a fresh multiplayer match or a loaded multiplayer save. Keep compact prompts in the game language; singleplayer and ordinary individual Quit remain unchanged.
Preserve exact local Lord/AIV sources and effective map or Custom-Coop mission settings when restoring the lobby; retain normal content and readiness validation.
Allow intentional AI, map, team and settings changes in the restored lobby with a chat notice. A refused automatic start leaves time for manual editing and retry.
Keep legitimate Coop host/guest building permissions separate from shared launch identity and wait for the client's actual mission/swap setup pass.
Use protocol v4 to verify the actual new target configuration on every peer before releasing the one-shot seed. Every peer needs this testmod and APIShared 0.69.0 or newer.
Hold the host's one-shot start seed until every original participant has finished loading the replacement map, preventing loss to the lobby receiver and a black map.
Use the existing Vanilla Restart Mission button through APIShared's general Vanilla-action override API; clients cannot restart and no duplicate action is added.
Use restart protocol v3; every participant needs the same testmod and APIShared 0.64.0 or newer.
Use the game language for restart messages and short confirmation headings in every supported language.
Wait for production-rule agreement before automatically pressing Ready and limit retries after another start guard rejects the command.
Require APIShared 0.62.1 to recover the production-rule agreement after a lobby change.
